mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO crushed_stone_pile_hot (device_id, collect_time, seq, run_depth, run_current, run_water_press, run_weight_add, run_state, type, create_ts) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{collectTime}, #{seq}, #{runDepth}, #{runCurrent}, #{runWaterPress}, #{runWeightAdd}, #{runState}, #{type}, #{createTs})
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_id, collect_time, seq, run_depth, run_current, run_water_press, run_weight_add, run_state, type, create_ts FROM crushed_stone_pile_hot WHERE collect_time >= #{start} AND collect_time <= #{end} ORDER BY collect_time DESC
SELECT id, device_id, collect_time, seq, run_depth, run_current, run_water_press, run_weight_add, run_state, type, create_ts FROM crushed_stone_pile_hot WHERE id = #{id}
